label: Worldwise deletion excludes a necessary concretum at any world of the same profile
paraphrase: Closed result about the formal readings, attribution deferred: for every profile m and world w, if worldwise deletion holds for m's Ontic and concreteness predicate (every concrete individual existing at any world v is absent from some world accessible from v, 2f055224), then no concrete individual exists at w and at every world accessible from w (b19ffd92 fails at w). Deletion at w applied to the would-be witness gives an accessible world lacking it. Neither reading is asserted; the certificate shows only that they cannot both hold at one world of one profile.
